On the table, there is a glass of water, a plate with fried chicken, and a plate with a piece of roll cake. Two other people are partially visible, one holding a fork over the cake. The background is a clean, modern white kitchen with white cabinetry and a white tiled backsplash. (2) The scene shifts to the woman sitting on a beige sofa in a brightly lit room. She is reading a large yellow book. An arm enters the frame from the left and taps her shoulder. She looks up and talks to the person off-camera, gesturing with her hands. Later, she stands up with a concerned look, holding her phone to her ear as if taking an urgent call. (3) The woman is now seated at a square table covered with a green cloth, playing Mahjong with green tiles. She appears concentrated. A person in a blue and white striped shirt stands behind her, placing a hand on her back. A red 'wasted' graphic overlay appears over the woman's torso. (4) In a bathroom setting with soft lighting, the woman stands before a large circular mirror. She wears the blue shirt and touches her neck and forearm with her fingers, looking worried. The background shows white walls and a white sink area. (5) The woman, now wearing a thick white bathrobe, stands in a brightly lit bathroom holding a white and green bottle of CeraVe Foaming Cleanser. She smiles widely at the camera, pointing at the bottle. The scene cuts to a close-up of her palm as clear gel is pumped onto it. She applies white foam to her face in circular motions, then rinses with water at a black faucet. Finally, she stands holding four different CeraVe bottles, smiling confidently.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo, upbeat electronic background music featuring a prominent, steady beat. A female voice speaks with moderate conversational loudness and a friendly tone. A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates the start. (2) The music continues at approximately 120 BPM. A short, percussive impact SFX is heard as an object is placed on a table. The female speaker's pitch rises slightly as she expresses frustration. (3) A new phase is triggered by the sound of shuffling paper or a book being opened. A second, older female voice enters the mix, speaking rapidly with high arousal. (4) Multiple sharp, plastic clicks of Mahjong tiles being moved are heard. A loud, distorted 'bass-boosted' meme sound effect occurs suddenly, creating a low-frequency peak. (5) The BGM transitions to a more polished, commercial-style pop track. A professional male narrator with a deep, authoritative yet energetic voice begins. High-pitched 'sparkle' SFX and liquid 'squelch' pumping sounds are layered over the speech. (6) Water splashing and rushing sounds are prominent as the woman is heard laughing softly. The narrator continues with high articulation clarity and an enthusiastic rising intonation. The track ends with a clean fade-out of the music and a final 'ding' bell sound.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable 'POV' (Point of View) comedy format to showcase various life situations where 'sensitivity'—emotional or physical—occurs. It effectively bridges these humorous social stressors to the physical issue of skin sensitivity, positioning CeraVe cleansers as the essential solution for maintaining skin stability and health.
